records.creator_description: Bumblebees and honeybees buzzing around a wisteria bush in an urban garden in Spring. The location is basically the same as in my Home ambience journal pack, but much closer to the wisteria bush. I haven't put it in that pack because of the change of microphone position and recording level. The wisteria blooms around the last week of April or first week of May, producing an enormous bounty of bright purple blossoms, filling the air with its scent, and attracting all of the bees that you hear. The recorder is placed right up among the blossoms, but you can still hear various sounds of the surrounding environment: passing cars, sirens, wind chimes, wind, human activity, and birds (Northern Cardinal and Carolina Wren). Recorded on 2025-05-07 at about 16:30. Recorder: Sony PCM-D50, mics in 120-degree (wide) position, using a windscreen. Processing: 2-octave high-pass filter at 100Hz.

And now, for the first time, we are bringing to you the full story of what happened on that fateful day. We are giving you all the evidence, based only on the secret testimonies of the miserable souls who survived this terrifying ordeal. The  incidents, the places, my friend we cannot keep this a secret any longer. Let us punish the guilty, let us reward the innocent. records.creator_description: Subject : The traffic at the crossing of D600 and D988. Placed near the buss station Rue Porta side. Date YMD : 2025 06 07 (Saturday). Early morning. Time = 06h54 finishing 07h03 Location : Albi 81000 Tarn Occitanie France. Hardware : Tascam FR-AV2, Rode NT5 with WS8 windshield. Had a pouch with the recorder, cables up my sleeve and mic in hand. Weather : Grey sky. Little to no wind, comfy temperature. Processing : Trimmed in Audacity. Other edits like filter, denoise etc… In the sound’s metadata. Notes : An early morning sound exploration trip. I heard a traffic light button a few days earlier and wanted to record it at a calmer time. So I took a walk recording a few sounds including this one :) Tips : Attribution is greatly appreciated but not required. Recommendation : X sound by Sadiquecat on Freesound.org in CC0 licence. Hope you enjoy :) PS: Id love to hear how you use this sound, feel free to link your creations or share how/why you listen to this :)

Fade in/out applied in Audacity.

In the background, the rain can be heard falling on other trees and structures in the backyard. Way in the distance, you can hear the slight sound of the ocean, which was relatively calm that night.
